description: An oscillator with three waveforms, pulse width control, and a level and stereo position on its output.

params.text: How much the FQ jack moves the pitch. With nothing patched into FQ this knob is a fine tune instead.
How much the FQ1 jack moves the pitch.
How much the FQ2 jack moves the pitch.
The pulse width of the square wave.
How much the PWM jack moves the pulse width.
Chooses the waveform: up is square, middle is a double saw, down is a sine.

inputs.text: Moves the pulse width, by as much as the MOD 2 knob allows.
Moves the pitch, at one volt per octave with the MOD 1 knob fully up.
Sets the pitch at one volt per octave.
Moves the pitch, at one volt per octave with the MOD knob beside FQ fully up.
Sets the output level, following an exponential curve.
Sets where the oscillator is placed across the stereo outputs.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.
An unpatched modulation CV jack does not read 0V: the firmware drives it from an internal chaotic generator, so a MOD knob turned up with nothing patched lets a wandering voltage through.
